title: Live-dead encounter histories of 11,192 common eiders ringed at Christianso, Denmark, 1973-1997
creator: Tjørnløv, Rune S.; Pradel, Roger; Choquet, Rémi; Christensen, Thomas Kjær; Frederiksen, Morten
citation: Tjørnløv, R., Pradel, R., Choquet, R., Christensen, T. K., & Frederiksen, M. (2020). Data from: Consequences of past and present harvest management in a declining flyway population of common eiders [Dataset]. Dryad. https://doi.org/10.5061/dryad.97h25b0
abstract: Burnham live-dead (LDLD) histories of common eiders (Somateria mollissima) ringed at Christianso, Denmark (Baltic Sea), 1973-1997: 5507 adult females, 5685 ducklings; per year, whether the bird was encountered alive at the colony and whether it was recovered dead (mostly by hunters) in the following interval. The MARK input of Tjornlov et al.'s harvest analysis.
samplingProtocol: Ringing of breeding adults and ducklings at the colony with annual recapture or resighting at the colony and dead recoveries reported through the ringing scheme (mostly hunting); one live occasion and one recovery interval per year.
closureNote: open between years (Burnham live-dead model; one live occasion and one recovery interval per year)

stateCodes.0: not encountered in year t (live 0, dead 0)
stateCodes.1: encountered alive at the colony in year t (live 1, dead 0)
stateCodes.2: recovered dead in the interval after year t (live 0, dead 1)
stateCodes.3: encountered alive in year t and recovered dead in the following interval (live 1, dead 1)

geographicCoverage: Christianso, Denmark (Baltic Sea); recoveries along the Baltic-Wadden Sea flyway; no coordinates deposited

notShipped.colony_file: Step1_Colonyspecific_capture_recapture_recovery.inp: 11 group columns with no legend in the deposit
notShipped.esurge_file: Step2 E-SURGE multievent cause-of-death file: event codes not defined in the deposit

notes: Adults are at risk from 1973 (caught in the wild); ducklings from their year of ringing (E4.4). Rows end at the year of dead recovery. unit_group is the MARK group. Unit ids follow the deposit order.
